source.citation: Axis-aligned bounding box of LILYGO's vendor STEP model '3D_PCB_T-CameraPlus-S3_V1.2_202505091545.step' (sha256 b5ac26860e33f3bd993dd62b1d48909a6dc07cad7c528cfb54852ad20fbb9487, 68,603,684 bytes, from github.com/Xinyuan-LilyGO/T-CameraPlus-S3 structure/ at commit 55764fa22a0dd2ea66715b2b5dc403a34569ba42), computed 2026-09-11 with OCCT 7.9.3 (cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1) BRepBndLib::AddOptimal after 0.05 mm incremental meshing; the STEP declares MM. Extents 29.9999 x 69.6625 x 10.8643 mm in the model's own frame, which is board-aligned with Z as the board normal (no axis permutation applied); rounded up to 0.01. Z runs from the lowest underside feature (4.71 mm below the model's z=0) to the tallest top-side component; the model carries no pin headers. This is the **V1.2** hardware revision (2025-04, per the repo README's version table); a separate STEP exists for V1.0-V1.1 (3D_PCB_T-CameraPlus-S3_V1.0-V1.1_202505091545.step) and was not measured. The STEP is the only dimensional source: the V1.2 schematic (T-CameraPlus-S3_V1.2_20240417.pdf, sha256 5363097ad586a5bf21cdd528fa8c0213b08e6af951835b1f8533531a64a202e2) is electrical only, and neither the README nor lilygo.cc's product page states board dimensions. The product page also lists an OV5640 SKU (H703-01); the model's camera module is not identified in the file, so the OV5640 variant's height is unverified. What the model does say, from a census of all 825 solids (BRepBndLib::Add, coarse boxes, 2026-09-12): the extreme z faces belong to exactly two features. The top is a single solid 6.2995 x 6.0000 x 5.0000 mm spanning z 1.1412 to 6.1412 -- a lens-barrel shape, the tallest thing on the board by 1.80 mm over the next component (8.9500 x 7.4500 x 4.2000 mm, reaching 4.3412). The bottom is -4.7100. Those two numbers are the whole of z: 6.1412 - (-4.7100) = 10.8512, rounded up to 10.87. Which solid is the camera is still not established -- geometry alone cannot say, and no silkscreen or placement file was consulted -- so this is not a claim that the barrel is the OV2640. It does make the open question a single measurement rather than a disassembly: an OV5640 board's **overall** thickness, lowest underside feature to highest top-side feature, compared against 10.85. Above it, the envelope is wrong for that SKU and z must be re-derived; at or below it, this envelope covers both. No such measurement has been made, and no vendor publishes the module height -- LILYGO's product page, the repo README and the resellers' listings were all checked on 2026-09-12 and none states one.
